text:
maya: quick q — planning to open the feature flag `eu_per_tenant_batching` for 30% of EU traffic at 11:00 UTC today. who can own the flip + smoke checks? :clock11:

alex: i can take the flip. will be at my desk 10:50–11:30 UTC. will run the smoke script and monitor latency/cpu for the pool.

sam: assigned on rollbacks. if anything spikes >20% p50 or error rate >0.5%, hit the rollback plan and ping oncall.

maya: awesome. smoke checklist for reference:
```
- confirm config gated to eu-only
- run `curl` to priming endpoint x5
- tail logs for 2 mins (`k logs -n inference eu-pool --since 2m`)
- verify p50 and p95 in datadog dashboard `EU Batch`
```
rita: quick question — what's the safe default? is it off or per-tenant=low?

maya: safe default is `off` globally. we flip a config override for eu region -> `percentage: 30` only. if rollback, we go back to `off`.

alex: noted. i'll post a short runbook when i flip. will also set a temp alert: `eu.batch.latency > baseline*1.2 for 3m` to pager.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout window created by maya for 2026-11-02T11:00:00Z -> 2026-11-02T11:15:00Z (id: roll-3177654321).

oncall-bot: on-call: rita (pager) until 12:00 UTC.

sam: rollback plan summary — command to revert: `fluxctl set -f config/eu-batch-override.yaml --rollback` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-eu` ; expected ~2m to stabilize.

rita: i'll watch charts and take pager if alert triggers. alex — want me to run the priming requests or you?

alex: i'll run priming, thanks. i'll ping here when complete and then flip.

maya: perfect. timeline: 10:50 alex on desk, 10:55 priming, 11:00 flip -> 11:05 smoke -> 11:15 decision to widen or hold. if anything abnormal, rollback immediately and post root cause.

rita: ack :+1:

sam: ack, i'll standby for rollback.

alex: prepping now, will post `done priming` before flip.

maya: thanks folks — tagging a11y and product for awareness: @product (no action required unless you see anomalies).
